✔ Upload videos directly to Facebook

✔ 1 new FREE animation of Tom scratching the screen

✔ Several bugfixes

We added a lot of new features in this update:
✔ Save videos to your Library (Photos -> Camera Roll)*
✔ Send videos as MMS (from Camera Roll)*
✔ Video length increased to 45 seconds
✔ Retina display compatible icons and buttons
✔ Smoother animations on iPhone 3G

*iPhone 3G users cannot save & send videos as MMS

✔ Video recording bug fixes
✔ Small performance improvement on iPhone 3G
